description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NSF NHERI 2024: Aerodynamic Wind Load Assessment of Parallel Solar Panels: Evaluating Surface-Rooftop Pressure Correlations is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Arindam Gan Chowdhury, Florida International University (fiu.edu). Wind loads on parallel photovoltaic (PV) panel arrays mounted on low-rise roofs were investigated using an open-circuit, atmospheric boundary-layer wind tunnel. Specifically, the pressure coefficients on the bottom surface of the PV and the rooftop were compared. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-w41b-4j65. Keywords: NSF NHERI FIU Wall of Wind Experimental Facility, Wind Engineering, Photovoltaics (PVs), Pressure Taps, Aerodynamic Wind Testing. Published 2024-08-14. Facility named: Wall of Wind - Florida International University. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
